intro: Comburglar and VoidLink were the primary threat actors associated with the persistence tag across six high-severity incidents reported between April 13 and April 28, 2026. The attacks primarily targeted the government, technology, and multiple sectors globally. Each of these distinct actors was observed in separate campaigns, with no affiliations or origins provided in the reporting. The coverage focused on the technical methods used to maintain unauthorized access, reflecting a concentrated period of activity with all six articles rated as high severity.
